Title: Azure SQL—General availability updates for early July 2023

Body.Content:
In early July 2023, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL:

  • Boost performance for demanding applications with a new 128 vCore option on standard-series hardware in Azure SQL Database.
  • Enable higher end compute and memory choices for better performance with Azure SQL Database Hyperscale premium series.
  • Use feedback persistence and a new feedback algorithm for an improved memory grant feedback experience with Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Database Hyperscale.
Body.Markdown:
